comparison_type: Exploratory comparison of existing experiments; not a controlled ablation
interpretation: Recognition experiments in Notebook 10 used only two epochs and produced very low test accuracy.
The existing Notebook 04 baseline result is from a different training run/configuration; these results should not be treated as a controlled comparison.
Traditional augmentation has a higher recorded test accuracy than the Notebook 10 original-only run, but this does not establish a reliable improvement.
GAN conditioning labels are not verified biometric identity labels.
Generated-image low-level statistics do not establish visual realism or identity preservation.
Membership-inference ROC-AUC values near 0.5 indicate little score-based separation in the sampled audit, not proof of no privacy leakage.
No formal multi-seed, matched-budget ablation was conducted.
